proposal: MID-WEEK (Tue/Wed core) CLEANUP - upstream of the Monday/Friday fix
author: specialist C (core intraday tape)
session: S104 solo mission (Greg: 'missed Monday because missed Friday; Friday inherits from mid-week')
forward_evidence: NONE (retrospective across the walked record; must be forward-tested on G17+)
scope_note: Additive ONLY. Incumbents (reasoning_method.giveback_exhaustion_boundary R1, mature_swing_alternation R4, giveback_origin_shelf_floor R5, chain_polarity, class_curve_profiles.young_extension) are NOT edited. These are amendments/sharpenings that make R5 FIRE and SIZE on mid-week Tue/Wed days, plus a new exit-read handoff protocol that feeds Thu/Fri downstream (D and E consume it; the Monday fix builds on it). Per-event, never pooled. Magnitudes DERIVED, honest under the actual where a tail was reactive.
source_data: renders/ng_refine_s95/g*_score.json (blind vs actual), g*_rt.json curve_2h (derived exit state: last_hour_dir, close_off_extreme), g15_mbo_evidence.json + g15_he24_he1_handoffs.json (exit states + D-1 trade tells). 44 scored Tue/Wed days across G6-G16 (G11 excluded - committed score file carries archetypes but no numbers).

midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback.one_line: A mid-week day that CLOSES AT its intraday extreme (close_off_extreme >= ~0.95) after a LARGE one-session directional run (>= ~$1200) passes forward a STRETCHED state; the NEXT session inherits GIVE-BACK / round-trip risk, NOT continuation. This is THE exit-read that breaks the mid-week -> Thu/Fri chain.
midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback.condition: day_class in {Tue,Wed} (any core day); the day's own move >= ~$1200 in one direction AND it closes within ~5% of its intraday extreme (coff>=0.95 on an up day / <=0.05 on a down day), high_late/low_late true.
midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback.behavior: The NEXT day's forecast must NOT extend the run. Flip the inherited assumption from continuation to GIVE-BACK: on a stretched-HIGH close expect a next-day fade DOWN; on a stretched-LOW close expect a next-day bounce UP. The counter-move is a give-back, not a new chain - band it modest (-$300..-$1200 class), do NOT claim the full round-trip, and it is CAPPED unless a fresh chain-sided catalyst arrives.
midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback.why_it_fails_now: The blind reads a big directional close as MOMENTUM and extends it into Thu/Fri. On the six cleanest stretched-HIGH closes it extended UP and eight-figure-missed the give-back.

midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback.derived_magnitude: The robust, decision-time claim is the SIGN of the inherited assumption: STOP EXTENDING the run - the next day counter-moves. The counter-move SIZE is variable (-13% to -106% of the stretched run) so band it, do not point-forecast the round-trip. Practical: set next-day continuation to ~0 and the give-back band to -$300..-$1200 (high side) / +$300..+$700 capped bounce (low side, a give-back not a chain-birth).
midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback.counterexample_and_scope: coff 0.90-0.94 is NOT clean: g8 0126 Wed +1370 coff0.95 -> Thu +170 (flat, mild), g12 0204 Wed +1260 coff0.93 -> Thu +510 (continued up). The exception is a YOUNG fresh-turn day (chain age 0-1) still building - see midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band; interaction rule: the stretched-close give-back is VOID on the 1st-2nd session of a fresh turn (that leg is still repricing). Threshold coff>=0.95 AND chain age >= 2.
midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback.day_class_validity: Tue/Wed core; the inheritance is consumed by the following Thu/Fri (and, across a weekend, by Sunday/Monday via the anchor CLOSE).

midweek.prior_exit_lasthour_magnitude_ga.one_line: For a mid-week TURN/reversal day, the PRIOR session's last_hour_dir gates the MAGNITUDE: if the prior exited AGAINST the coming turn, the turn realizes POST-OPEN (a seam/stop-run event) -> size the CONFIRMED base, never front-run the reactive tail. If the prior exited WITH the move, momentum carries -> size FULL, do not cap.
midweek.prior_exit_lasthour_magnitude_ga.condition: a mid-week day identified as a turn/reversal (direction already set by R5/giveback_origin_shelf_floor or the reversal-recognition play below); compare prior-day last_hour_dir (sign of the final-2h cum change) to the turn direction.
midweek.prior_exit_lasthour_magnitude_ga.behavior: prior_exit_dir OPPOSES turn -> the reversal is a post-open realization; cap magnitude at the confirmed retrace-to-shelf base and hold confidence moderate (the overshoot is reactive, not yours at the open). prior_exit_dir ALIGNS with the move -> carry the momentum; do NOT apply the mid-week cap (the blind's systematic under-size).

midweek.prior_exit_lasthour_magnitude_ga.derived_magnitude: opposing-exit reversal confirmed base = retrace-to-shelf (~+1200..+1600 off a deep down-extreme); reactive overshoot beyond the shelf is not claimed at the open. aligned-exit = full class band, no mid-week cap.
midweek.prior_exit_lasthour_magnitude_ga.does_not_explain: does NOT by itself FLIP direction (that is midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_recognition); it only SIZES a turn already identified. Silent on thin-holiday day-class moves and on post-crash DOUBLE bounces (g12 0203+0204) where it under-predicts the second leg.

midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_rec.one_line: The mis-called down-resume. When a DOWN-chain is MATURE (age>=3) AND price sits at a cum-extreme / origin-consolidation shelf AND the prior 1-2 sessions carry an EXHAUSTION TELL (a large sell flow ABSORBED with price holding, OR an extreme big-print sell-climax closing at the low), the next mid-week day is a GIVE-BACK-EXHAUSTION REVERSAL UP - not the chain-resume/giveback-continue DOWN the blind keeps calling.
midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_rec.condition: day_class core; chain_polarity down with chain_age>=3; cum_from_anchor at/near the block extreme OR price at the swing's origin shelf (>=~75% retrace per R5); D-1 tape shows absorption (large signed sell flow, price holds/rises) or an extreme sell-climax big_print_b_share at the low.
midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_rec.behavior: FLIP the mid-week call from down-resume to reversal UP. This is R5's inversion (capitulation-at-stretched-extreme precedes the bounce) applied on a Tue/Wed - the blind has been failing to RECOGNIZE it mid-week. Then size via midweek.prior_exit_lasthour_magnitude_gate.
midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_rec.why_it_fails_now: The blind's archetype vocabulary ('mature_swing_giveback', 'resume_downchain', 'chain resume DOWN', 'giveback_chain_continue') defaults to CONTINUING the down-chain and treats the mature-extreme as more downside, exactly inverting R5. It is a SELECTOR/recognition failure, not a missing rule.

midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_rec.derived_magnitude: confirmed retrace to the prior consolidation shelf (R5 floor becomes the target on the way UP); typical +1200..+1600 off a 3+ session down-extreme; overshoot beyond the shelf is reactive (see the magnitude gate).
midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_rec.does_not_explain: does NOT fire when the down-chain is YOUNG (age<3) and still extending (those correctly continue down, e.g. g15 0324 -380); requires the D-1 exhaustion tell - absent it, defer to the chain. Bidweek/catch-up ratify days (g13 0217) and pre-EIA coil days (g16 0401) are a different (catalyst-timing) failure this rule does NOT cover.
requires: D-1 trade tape: absorption or sell-climax (decision-time-legit, open-conditions)

midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band.one_line: A FRESH young (chain age 0-1) CHAIN-SIDED extension with aligned D-1 flow delivers the FULL band; do NOT apply counter-print damping (that is scoped to COUNTER prints only). Corrects the blind's systematic mid-week under-sizing of fresh turns.
midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band.condition: day_class core; chain age 0-1 (1st-2nd session since a fresh turn/catalyst); the day's move is CHAIN-SIDED (with the new chain) and D-1 flow aligns.
midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band.behavior: size the FULL class band, no mid-week cap. Interacts with midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback: on the 1st-2nd session of a fresh turn a stretched-high close is STILL BUILDING (void the give-back inheritance for one more session).

g14 0311 Wed shock-class cold-add (fresh chain-sided driver): blind +800, ACTUAL +2030

midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band.does_not_explain: does NOT license extending a MATURE swing (R4: mature swings give back, not extend); requires chain age 0-1 AND chain-sided AND aligned flow.

corrected_exit_read_protocol.purpose: The standardized EXIT read a mid-week specialist HANDS FORWARD (D/E and the Monday fix consume it). It is STATE, never the day-net. Emit at every mid-week close.

fields.last_hour_dir: sign of the final-2h cum change (curve_2h[-1]-curve_2h[-2]): did the turn begin AT the boundary? gates next-day magnitude (magnitude_gate)
fields.close_off_extreme: coff: closed AT the high (>=0.95) / AT the low (<=0.05) = STRETCHED -> give-back inheritance; 0.3-0.7 = balanced
fields.run_size_and_stretched_flag: the day's one-session move; stretched = run>=~1200 AND coff at extreme
fields.chain_polarity_and_age: down/up and sessions since the turn - gates young-extends-vs-mature-gives-back (R4) and reversal-recognition (age>=3)
fields.exhaustion_state: D-1/own-day absorption (large signed flow, price holds) or big-print climax at the extreme = reversal primed; none = chain intact
fields.conviction_verdict: flow_conviction = sign(signed_flow)*sign(price_change): ALIGNED = trend healthy; NEGATIVE-under-rising = absorption/covering = turn risk
fields.what_next_day_inherits: the explicit instruction: EXTEND vs EXPECT-GIVE-BACK vs REVERSAL-PRIMED-DO-NOT-FRONT-RUN

the_three_inheritance_verdicts: STRETCHED-EXTREME CLOSE (coff>=0.95, run>=1200, chain age>=2) -> next day STOP EXTENDING, expect a capped give-back (midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback).

MATURE-DOWN-CHAIN AT SHELF/EXTREME + D-1 EXHAUSTION TELL -> next day REVERSAL UP primed; the turn realizes post-open if this day exited DOWN, so size the confirmed shelf-retrace base and DO NOT front-run the tail (recognition + magnitude_gate).
YOUNG CHAIN-SIDED EXTENSION (age 0-1, aligned flow) -> next day CARRIES the chain at FULL band; void the give-back inheritance for one more session (young_chain_extension_full_band).

one_line_for_the_chain: The mid-week EXIT READ (stretched-close -> give-back; mature-shelf+tell -> reversal primed; young-chain -> carry) is what Thu/Fri must inherit instead of naive continuation; the prior-exit last_hour_dir then GATES the magnitude. Fix the mid-week exit read and the Friday inheritance stops handing the Monday a wrong anchor.
